# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Oil nears $97 after reported mine hits on two tankers and a strike on a Saudi refinery.](https://fiopoin.com/): Friday, November 27, 2026. Brent crude rose to $97.31 a barrel on Friday after Iran's IRGC said two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia said a strike suspended some operations at its Jazan refinery on November 26. OPEC+ meets Sunday.
- [Stocks and your savings: Asian stocks rally and US futures rise before Wall Street's Black Friday half day.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Oil and the Gulf: Oil climbs as Iran's IRGC says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz and a strike shuts part of a Saudi refinery.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [Deals and companies: Altria says it may make a cash offer for Imperial Brands, and Imperial's shares jump 13.3%.](https://fiopoin.com/#deals)
- [Central banks and your loans: EU leaders pick Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos to lead the ECB as Tokyo inflation hits a 16 month high.](https://fiopoin.com/#rates)
